ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (38) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Разум» (razum) is 'reason', «неразумный» (nerazumny) 'unreasonable', and «несвободный» (nesvobodny) 'unfree'; «благо для всех» (blago dlya vsekh) in Lucy Mallory is 'the good for all'. Attributions follow the print («Карлейль», Karleyl', 'Carlyle', not expanded; «Буддийская мудрость. Дхаммапада», 'Buddhist wisdom. Dhammapada'), and in saying 2 a comma evidently missing after «зло» (zlo, 'evil') is supplied in the sense (see flags).
Source observation: [7] «Если нет в тебе желания делать зло честолюбия» reads as if a comma has dropped after «зло» ('no desire to do evil, no ambition'); translated in that evident sense.
